note: Deterministic scoring rubric (§44.5). The escalation rule and evidence requirements are fixed here, BEFORE runs. An optional model judge may flag narrative quality but never manufactures labels or overrides these checks.

escalation.rule: escalate iff disposition is malicious AND (incident_category in critical_categories OR max cited severity >= severity_escalate_at)

scoring.evidence_quality: fraction of cited record_ids that exist AND reference a claimed affected entity
scoring.unsupported_penalty: an escalation with zero valid citations scores evidence_quality 0 and is a false-escalation candidate
